title: In vitro quantification of pigment production and transfer in 2D co-cultures and 3D skin organotypic
protocol: Trpsinize and count keratinocytes using 0.25% Trypsin.
Incubate the keratinocyte dish for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Neutralize with 10% FBS in PBS (1:1 ratio) after trypsinization of keratinocytes.
Collect the cells from the keratinocyte dish into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant using vacuum aspirator.
Add 1 ml of cell media to resuspend the keratinocytes and mix thoroughly.
Count the number of keratinocytes.
Trpsinize melanocytes using 0.05% Trypsin.
Incubate the melanocyte dish for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Neutralize with 10% FBS in PBS (1:1 ratio) after trypsinization of melanocytes.
Collect the cells from the melanocyte dish into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant using vacuum aspirator.
Add 1 ml of cell media to resuspend the melanocytes and mix thoroughly.
Count the number of melanocytes.
Seed approximately 4 × 10^4 cells per growth area cm² for maximum density in co-culture experiments.
Calculate the number of keratinocytes and melanocytes needed based on the dish size; for example, seed 8.4 × 10^5 keratinocytes and 8.4 × 10^4 melanocytes in a 6 cm dish.
Add required cell volumes to achieve the desired population in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant using vacuum aspirator.
Add 1 ml of melanocyte media and mix well.
Seed cells on respective dishes.
Top up with melanocyte media.
Incubate for 18-24 h at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Add 0.25% Trypsin to dishes.
Incubate for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Neutralize with 10% FBS in PBS (1:1 ratio).
Collect cells in 5 mL round bottom polystyrene tubes.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant using vacuum aspirator.
Add 4% PFA to tubes.
Incubate for 15 min.
Wash cells in 2 mL 1 × PBS.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Repeat washing step once.
Add 1 mL of permeabilization buffer (0.2% gelatin, 0.1% Triton X, 0.1% SDS).
Incubate for 15 min.
Wash cells in 2 mL 1 × PBS.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Repeat washing step once.
Add primary antibody mix of 1:100 K14 antibody and 1:100 GP100 antibody in 1 × PBS.
Incubate for 1 h with occasional shaking.
Wash cells in 2 mL 1 × PBS.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Add secondary antibody mix of 1:1000 Donkey Anti-Rabbit IgG H&L (Alexa Fluor ® 488) and 1:1000 Donkey Anti-Mouse IgG
Incubate H&L (Alexa Fluor ® 594) with occasional shaking for 40 minutes.
Wash with 2 mL 1 × PBS.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 800 μL of 1 × PBS and mix well.
Add Hoechst 33342 to the tube in a ratio of 1:1000.
Filter through filter paper to remove small clumps of cells.
Proceed for FACs analysis against APC-A and Alexa Fluor 488-A.
Identify single positive population for APC-A as melanocytes.
Identify single positive population for Alexa Fluor 488-A as keratinocytes.
Identify double positive population for both APC-A and Alexa Fluor 488-A as keratinocytes which have taken up melanin.
Trpsinize co-cultured cells from dishes.
Add 0.25% trypsin to dishes.
Incubate for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Neutralize with 10% FBS in PBS (1:1 ratio).
Collect in 5 mL round bottom polypropylene tubes.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant using vacuum aspirator.
Stain co-cultured cells using c-Kit antibody.
Add primary antibody mix of 1:100 c-Kit antibody in 10% FBS in PBS.
Incubate on ice for 1 h with occasional shaking.
Wash cells in 2 mL 10% FBS in PBS, then centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Add secondary antibody mix of 1:1000 Donkey Anti-Mouse IgG H&L (Alexa Fluor® 647) antibody in 10% FBS in PBS.
Incubate on ice for 40 min with occasional shaking.
Wash cells in 2 mL 10% FBS in PBS, then centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Add 800 μL of 10% FBS in PBS.
Mix well.
Add Hoechst 33342 into the tube in a ratio of 1:1000.
Filter through filter paper.
Proceed for live sorting against [640] 670/30 - APC and collect cells positive and negative in c-Kit staining in separate tubes.
Collect 2 × 10^5 c-Kit- cells.
Collect 2 × 10^4 c-Kit+ cells.
Centrifuge collection tubes at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Add lysis buffer (Lysis M + 1× PI) into respective tubes.
For c-Kit- cells, add 100 μL of lysis buffer.
For c-Kit+ cells, add 50 μL of lysis buffer.
Transfer mix into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 14,000 rpm for 10 min.
Transfer supernatant into a new Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 min.
Discard supernatant.
Dissolve melanin pellet in 120 μL 1 M NaOH.
Incubate at 80°C for 1 h.
Prepare melanin standards according to the table provided in materials and equipment.
Incubate melanin solution at 80°C for 1 h.
Measure absorbance of melanin at 476 nm.
Transfer samples in duplicates to a 96 well Greiner clear, flat bottom plate.
Analyze and quantify melanin content against standards.
Establish 3D in vitro co-culture of full thickness epidermal skin equivalent.
On day -4, cast collagen gel + fibroblast mix.
Have confluent dish of fibroblasts trypsinized on ice at a concentration of 1 × 10^6/mL.
Perform all steps on ice with cold pipette tips to prevent premature polymerization of collagen.
Aliquot 500 μL of Collagen Type I into a cold 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Neutralize collagen with 1 M NaOH dropwise until neutral pH is obtained.
Add 1 × 10^5 MT fibroblasts to the neutralized collagen and mix well.
Plate the mixture onto membrane support ThinCerts™ cell culture inserts with pore size of 0.4 μm in a 12-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Check that the collagen is completely solidified after about 30 minutes.
Add 1 ml of fibroblast media into the 12-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Seed a co-culture of 10 keratinocytes to 1 melanocyte in a 2D in vitro co-culture on a hardened collagen gel.
Suspend the co-cultured cells in 3D co-culture condition media for a 12-well insert, corresponding to 2 × 10^5 keratinocytes and 2 × 10^4 melanocytes.
Add 1 mL of 3D co-culture condition media into the 12-well tissue culture plate on day -2.
Refresh the media the next day with 200 μL of 3D co-culture condition media on the insert and 1 mL in the 12-well plate.
Change to differentiation media for 3D co-cultures on Day -1.
Elevate the 3D co-cultures to an air-liquid interface at Day 0.
Carefully remove all media from the 12-well insert until it is dry.
Change media every 2 days by adding 4 mL of differentiation media to the lower chamber of the deep well plate.
Remove any liquid observed on the insert during media changes using a pipette.
On day 10, harvest 3D co-culture from the insert and fix in 4% paraformaldehyde for 24 hours at 4°C.
Excise the harvested sample in half.
Embed one half in O.C.T. and the other half in cassettes for paraffin processing and embedding.
Collect 5 μm sections for FFPE and 10 μm sections for O.C.T. sections.
Stain 3D co-culture sections with Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) to observe histology.
Allow slides to dry before sealing them with coverslips.
Stain sections and analyze using Image J software.
Deparaffinize slide sections for FFPE samples.
Incubate in Target Retrieval Solution concentrate in a pressure cooker.
Add permeabilization buffer and incubate for 15 min.
Wash slides in 1 × PBS twice for 5 min each.
Add blocking buffer and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.
Incubate with primary antibody mix overnight at 4°C.
Wash slides in 1 × PBS three times, 5 min each wash.
Incubate with secondary antibody mix for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash slides in 1 × PBS twice for 5 min each.
Add Hoechst diluted 1:1000 in PBS and incubate for 15 min.
Wash slides in 1 × PBS twice for 5 min each.
Seal with Prolong Diamond Antifade mounting media.
Image under confocal microscope.
Measure the total length of the co-culture organotypic manually.
Load all files inside the input directory using Bio-Formats Macro Extensions.
Process bioformat files according to the script provided.
Import files ending with "lif" using Bio-Formats Importer plugin.
Duplicate the imported image stack and set it as the original image.
Select the duplicated image titled "melanosomes".
Duplicate the selected image, setting channels from 2 onwards for NKI designation.
Select the duplicated image and duplicate again to name it "basal".
Duplicate the selected image once more to name it "suprabasal".
Create an AND operation between images named "melanosomes" and "basal", then duplicate as "basal_melanin".
Apply Auto Threshold method Yen white for "basal_melanin".
Set threshold values from 1 to 255.
Convert the image to a mask using BlackBackground option set to true.
Divide the image by 255 and measure the results.
Create an AND operation between images named "suprabasal" and "basal", then duplicate as "basal_suprabasal".
Perform another AND operation creating an image titled "suprabasal_melanin".
Apply Auto Threshold method Yen white for "suprabasal_melanin".
